---
mode: agent
description: Review a Rust change against the repository rules without editing
---

Review `${input:target:diff, branch or files}`. Do not edit code.

Trace entry points through policy, state, persistence, effects and results.
Prioritise correctness, control safety, security, concurrency, failure handling,
competing authorities and unnecessary complexity. Check that tests support the
claimed behaviour and documentation reflects verified completion.

For each finding, give file/line evidence, trigger, consequence and a concrete
fix. Separate verified facts from assumptions and identify missing validation.
